name: quantum computing
expertise: a quantum computing researcher familiar with noise models, error budgets and the gap between simulated and hardware results
standards: the noise model and its parameters stated, and justified against real device data
qubit count, connectivity, gate set and circuit depth reported
a classical baseline the quantum method is actually compared against
shot counts and error bars on all measured quantities
any advantage claim scoped to the regime and hardware evaluated
red_flags: an advantage claim resting on a noiseless simulator
a classical baseline that is not the best known classical algorithm
resource estimates that omit error correction overhead
